recommendation: Keep this no-change audit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7886 unless a future work-group decision supersedes the Communication/Encounter phone-call boundary.
issue_request: FHIR-7886 was a Published Patient Care change request for FHIR-core Communication. It asked to add Communication duration and date support for phone-call use cases, but the final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead required a Boundaries and Relationships note directing patient phone calls to Encounter and allowing non-patient calls to use Communication only to represent transferred information.
initial_application: Git commit cb0f45f8046d76835cfdb0cdb337b059ac8d9762 explicitly listed #7886 and added the Communication and Encounter subsection to source/communication/communication-introduction.xml. The current active source still preserves that note, with only later editorial/refactoring changes around the same rule.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists communication=Communication under active [resources]. FHIR-7903 and FHIR-4872 are the same phone-call boundary family, and the combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-7903 reconciliation commit aligning the parallel Encounter page. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-7886 and broader Communication/Encounter phone-call terms found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Communication page already implements the FHIR-7886 resolution, and adding duration/date elements or duplicating the existing boundary note would not reflect the final Jira disposition.
